headline: Spot gold falls 1% as oil rebounds amid US-Iran talks
summary: Spot gold fell 1% to $3,906.21 an ounce as of 11:02 a.m. in London following an oil rebound amid a lack of progress in US-Iran deal talks.
why: Gold is a primary safe-haven asset, while crude oil and geopolitical developments in the Middle East heavily influence global commodity markets, inflation expectations, and currency valuations.
